nodes.text:
Mending words. Knitting words. The kind you say over someone who is still worth saying words over.

I don't teach the other kind. Ashell does, two doors down, and we don't speak.

Because he thinks a word is a word and I think a word is a choice.

The same breath that closes a wound opens one, if you turn it round. He finds that elegant. I find it a reason to be careful who I sell breath to.
